title: Event Horizon
description: Orbit a spinning black hole and see light from its accretion disk bend around the shadow.

title: Earth From Orbit
description: Move through a day in UTC and watch sunlight cross the real geography of Earth.

title: Cathedral Light
description: Move the sun through an autumn day and watch its light cross a Gothic nave.

title: The Night City
description: Scrub through dusk in a city built and lit in Margo Engine.

title: The Million Stars
description: Explore one million real 2MASS point sources and brush their near-infrared colors to see where they sit on the sky.

title: The Wrecking Ball
description: Release a miniature crane's linked pendulum into stacked blocks and compare how much of the tower falls.

title: The Domino Cascade
description: Tip one domino and follow the chain through a spiral, up a staircase and across a bridge.

title: The Engine Block
description: Section, inspect and export an exact four-cylinder CAD casting in Margo Engine.

title: Inside a Heat Pump
description: Reverse the refrigerant circuit, explore the heat exchangers and take apart a heat pump in Margo Engine.

title: Newton's Cradle
description: Release one or two polished steel balls and watch a contact pulse cross Newton's cradle.

title: The Analog Integrator
description: A working wheel-and-disk integrator in Margo Engine.

title: The Archimedes Screw
description: Turn an Archimedes screw and see the water pockets carry water from a lower pool to a raised basin.

title: The Astigmatism Bench
description: Slide the image plane of an astigmatic lens and see its spot turn from one line into another.

title: The Bellows

title: The Canal Lock

title: The Capillary Garden

title: The Capstan

title: The Chain Fountain
description: Run a chain fountain and see how contacts in its feed tray push the falling chain upward.

title: The Desert Mirage
description: Heat a desert road and trace the light that makes dry asphalt look like water.

title: The Dichroic Splitter
description: Tilt a thin-film dichroic plate and see how it divides white light between two optical paths.

title: The Differential
description: See how an open differential lets its wheels turn at different speeds.

description: Change the wavelength or groove density to move the diffraction orders across a precision angle scale.

title: The Echo Canyon

title: The Eddy Brake

title: The Flood Table

title: The Foucault Pendulum
description: Move a Foucault pendulum from one hemisphere to the other and watch its swing turn with Earth

title: The Fresnel Lens

title: The Gimbal

description: A working strain-wave gear cutaway in Margo Engine.

title: The Jewelry Counter

title: The Light Bench
description: Turn a slotted steel mask and watch a spotlight carve through a plaster sculpture.

title: The Magnetic Field Mapper

title: The Marble Sorter

title: The Moiré Press

description: Tune a listening room and see where bass builds up or cancels. An interactive acoustic exhibit

title: The Rolling Race

title: The Salt Wedge

title: The Sand Pendulum
description: Release a brass sand pendulum and draw a pattern from two swinging motions.

title: The Sarrus Linkage
description: A fold-out field platform demonstrating a Sarrus linkage in Margo Engine.

title: The Schlieren Bench
description: Slide a knife edge into a focused beam to reveal otherwise invisible temperature gradients above a heater.

title: The Scotch Yoke
description: Turn a crank and watch its roller drive a piston through a straight slot. A live mechanical exhibit

title: The Seismograph
description: Tune a tremor, watch the suspended mass and read the trace on a mechanical seismograph rendered in Margo Engine.

title: The Shadow Calendar
description: Follow a working bronze sundial through the day and across seasons.
